name: Lipolab (DIY fat-dissolving injections)

lead: Lipolab is a brand name used on looksmaxxing forums for injectable fat-dissolving solutions. Members inject small amounts into the cheeks and sometimes other areas, hoping to reduce fullness and reveal more facial definition.

The approach belongs to the wider family of injection lipolysis, in which compounds such as deoxycholate are injected to break down fat cells. One such compound, deoxycholic acid, is approved as a medical product for fullness under the chin; Lipolab itself is not an approved drug, and no published trials of the brand were found.

paras: Forum posts describe ordering the product online and self-injecting into the cheeks over several sessions spaced apart, with users reporting swelling for days afterwards and comparing before-and-after photos. Some members mention combining it with other debloating approaches.

Reported effects include marked swelling (one poster said classmates noticed and he was sent home), numbness, and lumps. Medical societies have cautioned against injection lipolysis in general, and the FDA has issued warning letters about unapproved fat-dissolving products. The face contains facial nerves, and forum guides themselves warn about the possibility of nerve injury.

lead: Lipolab is a brand name that appears on looksmaxxing forums for an injectable fat-dissolving product. Members use it to try to slim the lower face by injecting small amounts into fat pockets such as the buccal fat pads in the cheeks, with the goal of a more sculpted, defined cheek and jawline.[1][2]

The product type belongs to injection lipolysis, a cosmetic technique in which drug mixtures, most often phosphatidylcholine with deoxycholate, are injected into fat to destroy fat cells. One related compound, deoxycholic acid (Kybella), was approved by the FDA in April 2015 to reduce submental fullness.[3]

Published research on Lipolab as a brand has not been found. Research on injection lipolysis generally is described below, and professional societies and the FDA have issued cautions about unapproved products and about the practice.[3]

paras: Lipolab is discussed on looksmax.org as an injectable lipolysis product that members order online and administer themselves. Threads include first-session reports, requests for guidance, and result updates, and one guide thread frames the procedure as an immensely dangerous process because of facial nerves.[2][1]

The broader technique, injection lipolysis, uses mixtures that destroy fat cells; most formulations use phosphatidylcholine and deoxycholate. A German product, Lipostabil, containing these ingredients was approved there for other uses and has been used cosmetically.[3]

Forum users describe targeting the buccal fat pads, cheeks and lower face to look leaner, usually in multiple sessions with swelling that takes days to settle.[1] Some posters ask whether it can slim the nose, and one reported that swelling after cheek injections was obvious to classmates.[4]
Members debate technique, risk and results; some guides emphasise caution about nerves, while others describe the activity as a high-risk-tolerance DIY choice.

Injection lipolysis products with unapproved formulations drew FDA warning letters to six medspas and a Brazilian company on April 7, 2010; the FDA reported scarring, skin deformation and painful lumps. Three US professional societies have cautioned against the practice, and in the UK the MHRA warned about unlawful advertising of these products.[3]

Approved deoxycholic acid is described as having swelling, bruising and numbness as side effects, with nerve injury rare when administered by a qualified professional.[3] A forum thread title also reports facial numbness after a self-injection.[5]

No studies found on Lipolab by name. For the wider category, a randomized trial comparing phosphatidylcholine and deoxycholate injections has been published, and retrospective studies of Lipostabil have reported benefit; a Wikipedia summary notes that placebo-controlled safety and efficacy trials of the mixture are lacking, while deoxycholic acid alone has gained FDA approval for submental fat.[3]

lore.intro: On looksmax.org, Lipolab is presented as a do-it-yourself route to buccal-fat reduction, with threads mixing results updates and warnings.[1][2]
